content.description: Moni Discover helps you find promising crypto projects and track trends through real-time Twitter analytics. Rather than manually monitoring hundreds of accounts, you receive automated rankings, social scoring, and smart filters that surface early-stage opportunities. This approach saves hours of research, highlights emerging hype, and enables data-driven investment decisions with clearer signals. Moni Discover supports analysis across Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, Polygon, and Avalanche, helping you spot trends wherever they form.

resources.title: Scoring a Project by Who Follows It
resources.tldr: Weighting mentions by the quality of the person making them, so a hundred bots count for less than one credible builder.
